title.narrative: Multitranche Financing Facility (MFF) - National Power Grid Development Investment Program (Tranche1)

description.narrative: The investment program is designed to benefit all grid-connected consumers with adequate and reliable supply of electricity and is expected to support the achievement of the Government's goal of Power for all by 2012 by increasing transmission capacity and enhancing the reliability and efficiency of the transmission network.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: National Power Grid strengthening and augmentation/expansion with transmission bottlenecks removed and losses reduced.
Increased inter-regional transmission capacity Progress/Status: Achieved 28,000 MW Data Source: Regulation statistics of NLDC Quarterly project reports Actual value:

Maintained transmission system availability at par with international standards Progress/Status: Transmission losses in the range of 3-4% in 2013-14 Data Source: Program completion reports Actual value:
Development of an integrated national power grid Progress/Status: Achieved 92,981 ckm Data Source: Annual Report of Power Grid Actual value:

Maintained transmission system availability at par with international standards Progress/Status: Transmission system availability maintained at 99.94% in 2013-14 Data Source: Quarterly project reports ADB's project review mission Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: +/-800kV HVDC Northeastern? Northern /Western Interconnector Indicator: About 1800 km of ±800kV, 6000 MW HVDC bipole line by 2012 Progress/Status: All 17 contract packages awarded. Project under implementation. Out of 4849 nos. 4837 nos foundations completed. Tower erection has been completed for 4802 out of 4849. And Stringing completed for 1794.2 kms out of 1900.25 kms. Data Source: Annual report of POWERGRID Regulation statistics of NLDC Quarterly project progress reports. ADB's project review missions. Field visits Program completion report Actual value:

Northern /Western Interconnector Indicator: HVDC rectifier module of 3,000 MW at Biswanath Chariyali and inverter module of 3,000 MW at Agra by 2012 Progress/Status: Civil works for substation has been started and delivery of equipment has already been commenced and are at various levels of implementation.
